items.text: Check entry register for customer name, vehicle number, in-time and out-time. [Reference / Source: Vehicle Entry App / Gate Entry Register]
Check accessories, spares, belongings, tools and spare wheel are properly noted. [Reference / Source: Gate Register / Vehicle Inventory Sheet]
Check existing damages are recorded before vehicle enters workshop. [Reference / Source: Damage Pics / Inventory Sheet / Photos]
Check odometer and fuel level are recorded correctly. [Reference / Source: Gate Register / Inventory Sheet / Physical Vehicle]
Check vehicle exit is allowed only against authorised gate pass / delivery clearance. [Reference / Source: Gate Pass / DMS / Security Register Time Out]
Check customer is attended promptly on arrival. [Reference / Source: Reception Desk / Physical Observation / Token Register]
Check reception and customer waiting area are clean and organised. [Reference / Source: Physical Observation]
Check basic customer amenities are available and functional. (TV, AC, Water Bottles etc.) [Reference / Source: Customer Lounge / Physical Observation]
Check joint walk-around inspection is done with customer, where applicable. [Reference / Source: Physical Observation / MTab / Inventory Sheet]
Check scratches, dents and damages are marked clearly. [Reference / Source: MTab / Damage Diagram / Physical Vehicle]
Check vehicle photos are taken before repair starts. [Reference / Source: MTab Camera / Uploaded Photos]
Check customer receives vehicle-received confirmation. [Reference / Source: WhatsApp / SMS / Communication Record]
Check every vehicle under repair has an open Job Card. [Reference / Source: DMS / MTab / Physical Vehicle]
Check customer and vehicle details are correct on Job Card. [Reference / Source: Job Card / DMS / Vehicle]
Check all customer concerns are clearly written. [Reference / Source: Job Card / MTab]
Check pending jobs from previous visit are identified. [Reference / Source: Service History / Previous Job Card]
Check customer is informed of expected delivery timeline. [Reference / Source: WhatsApp / SMS / Call Log]
Check labour and parts estimate is prepared before chargeable work. [Reference / Source: Estimate / DMS / MTab]
Check estimate is shared with customer. [Reference / Source: Estimate / WhatsApp / Email]
Check customer approval is received before starting chargeable work. [Reference / Source: WhatsApp / Digital Approval / Approval Record]
Check declined jobs are recorded separately. [Reference / Source: Job Card / DMS / Estimate]
Check promised delivery time is reconfirmed after estimate approval, where required. [Reference / Source: WhatsApp / Call Log / DMS]
Check bay is allocated in system or control board. [Reference / Source: DMS / Bay Allocation Report / Control Board]
Check technician is assigned against the Job Card. [Reference / Source: DMS / Job Allocation]
Check assigned technician matches the person working on vehicle. [Reference / Source: Physical Observation / DMS / Job Allocation]
Check repair is carried out only against approved Job Card work. [Reference / Source: Job Card / Physical Vehicle / DMS]
Check start and completion status of repair is traceable. [Reference / Source: DMS / Job Status / Technician Clocking]
Check removed parts are handled and stored safely. [Reference / Source: Workshop Floor / Parts Return Area]
Check customer receives work-in-progress update for long repair jobs. [Reference / Source: WhatsApp / SMS / Call Log]
Check additional work is recorded before starting repair. [Reference / Source: Job Card / Revised Estimate / DMS]
Check additional cost is shared with customer. [Reference / Source: Revised Estimate / WhatsApp]
Check customer approval is received before additional work starts. [Reference / Source: WhatsApp / Digital Approval / Approval Record]
Check reason for stopped / held-up job is recorded. [Reference / Source: DMS / Hold-up Report / WIP Report]
Check parts-related delay is recorded and tracked. [Reference / Source: BO Report / DMS / Parts Pending Report]
Check customer is informed before original promised delivery time if delayed. [Reference / Source: WhatsApp / SMS / Call Log / DMS PDT]
Check revised promised delivery time is updated in system. [Reference / Source: DMS / Job Card / WIP Report]
Check parts are issued only against valid Job Card. [Reference / Source: DMS / Parts Issue Slip / Job Card]
Check all issued parts are traceable to vehicle / Job Card. [Reference / Source: DMS / Parts Issue Register]
Check pending / back-order parts are monitored. [Reference / Source: BO Report / DMS]
Check replaced parts are handled as per process. [Reference / Source: Replaced Parts Area / Job Card / Parts Record]
Check road test is done where required for diagnosis. [Reference / Source: Road Test Sheet / Job Card / DMS]
Check road test findings are recorded. [Reference / Source: Road Test Sheet / Job Card]
Check post-repair road test is done where required. [Reference / Source: Road Test Sheet / Job Card]
Check original customer concern is verified after repair. [Reference / Source: QC Checklist / Road Test Sheet / Job Card]
Check final QC is completed before vehicle is declared ready. [Reference / Source: QC Checklist / DMS / QC Area]
Check all approved jobs are verified as completed. [Reference / Source: QC Checklist / Job Card]
Check repeat repair vehicles receive extra technical / QC attention. [Reference / Source: QC Sheet / Repeat Repair Record]
Check customer is updated when repair is completed / vehicle moves to final QC. [Reference / Source: WhatsApp / SMS / Call Log]
Check exterior is properly cleaned. [Reference / Source: Physical Vehicle / Wash Bay]
Check interior is properly cleaned. [Reference / Source: Physical Vehicle / Wash Bay]
Check washed vehicle is moved to designated ready / delivery area. [Reference / Source: Physical Vehicle / Delivery Area]
Check bodyshop estimate is prepared before repair. [Reference / Source: DMS / Bodyshop Estimate]
Check insurance approval is available before insurance repair, where applicable. [Reference / Source: Insurance Portal / Approval Copy]
Check supplementary estimate approval is available for additional insurance work. [Reference / Source: Supplement Approval / Insurance Portal]
Check vehicle condition is protected during denting and painting. [Reference / Source: Physical Vehicle / Bodyshop Floor]
Check paint booth process / log is maintained. [Reference / Source: Paint Booth / Paint Log]
Check customer receives progress update for long bodyshop jobs. [Reference / Source: WhatsApp / SMS / Call Log]
Check invoice matches approved estimate and approved additional work. [Reference / Source: Invoice / Estimate / Approval Record]
Check all issued parts are billed, where chargeable. [Reference / Source: Parts Issue Register / Invoice]
Check labour billed matches work performed. [Reference / Source: Job Card / Invoice]
Check discounts / complimentary jobs have proper approval. [Reference / Source: Discount Approval / DMS / Approval Mail]
Check final payable amount is communicated to customer. [Reference / Source: Invoice / WhatsApp / Call Log]
Check vehicle is declared ready only after repair, QC and cleaning. [Reference / Source: DMS / QC Checklist / Physical Vehicle]
Check customer receives vehicle-ready update. [Reference / Source: WhatsApp / SMS / Call Log]
Check invoice and charges are explained to customer. [Reference / Source: Invoice / Delivery Checklist / Physical Observation]
Check declined / future jobs are explained, where applicable. [Reference / Source: Job Card / Delivery Checklist]
Check customer acknowledgement / signature is obtained. [Reference / Source: Delivery Checklist / Job Card / DMS]
Check delivery / thank-you confirmation is sent after handover. [Reference / Source: WhatsApp / SMS]
Check drop location and time are confirmed with customer. [Reference / Source: Smart Pick Portal / WhatsApp / Call Log]
Check vehicle dispatch time is recorded. [Reference / Source: Smart Pick Portal / Gate Register]
Check successful delivery / drop acknowledgement is available. [Reference / Source: Smart Pick App / Customer Acknowledgement]
Check warranty jobs are correctly identified and documented. [Reference / Source: Warranty Register / DMS / Job Card]
Check required warranty approval is available. [Reference / Source: Warranty Portal / Approval Record]
Check warranty parts are correctly identified and retained as required. [Reference / Source: Warranty Parts Area / Warranty Register]
Check technical diagnosis / escalation is documented for complex cases. [Reference / Source: Diagnostic Report / DMS / Technical Case Record]
Check workshop floor is clean and free from oil spills / obstructions. [Reference / Source: Physical Observation / Workshop Floor]
Check fire extinguishers are available, accessible and within validity. [Reference / Source: Physical Inspection / Fire Equipment Register]
Check emergency exits and passages are clear. [Reference / Source: Physical Observation]
Check waste oil, batteries and hazardous waste are stored in designated area. [Reference / Source: Waste Storage Area / Disposal Record]
Check EV / specialised vehicle is handled only in designated bay. [Reference / Source: EV Bay / Physical Observation]
Check only trained / authorised staff work on high-voltage vehicle systems. [Reference / Source: Training Record / Technician Allocation]
Check required EV safety PPE and insulated tools are available. [Reference / Source: EV Bay / Tool Inventory / Physical Observation]
Check high-voltage isolation / safety procedure is followed before repair. [Reference / Source: EV Safety Checklist / Job Card]
Check EV charging activity is recorded and controlled. [Reference / Source: Charging Log / EV Charging Area]
